這是場發生在海拔 2300 公尺的狂歡。LAMA 帶著他的卡西歐，跟著珠寶圈的前輩們A.K.A 「快樂國寶旅遊團」踏上一場看似接地氣的部落之旅，在意料之外的高山症發生時，照樣不斷freestyle，無意間在深山密林中觸發了超越時空的完美狀態。 本作大膽採用了充滿彈跳感與強烈碎拍的 電子 曲風，將高海拔的自然靈氣與極致躍動的電子鼓點進行碰撞。當都市的壓力與質疑聲在大鼓的重擊下被徹底碾碎，LAMA 以最純粹、不被定義的姿態，展現了與天地共振的狂喜。 「當我們在深山密林中卸下城市的武裝與社會的刻板標籤，達到與周遭環境融為一體的狀態時，Flow 不再是刻意編排的技巧，而是順應自然的本能流露。」 在夥伴與大自然的見證下，他將吸收到的經驗轉化為進化的養分，宣告著一個不受定義 沒有上限的 LAMA 3.0已經誕生。 This is a carnival at an altitude of 2300 meters. LAMA, armed with his Casio watch , embarks on a seemingly down-to-earth tribal journey with , a group of jewelry industry veterans known as the "Happy National Treasure Tour Group." When unexpected altitude sickness strikes, he continues to freestyle, unintentionally triggering a perfect, timeless state amidst the deep forests. This track boldly employs the bouncy, energetic Jersey Club style, colliding the natural spirit of high altitude with the extremely vibrant electronic drumbeats. As the pressures and doubts of the city are utterly crushed under the heavy drumbeats, LAMA, in the purest, undefined state, displays a ecstatic resonance with heaven and earth. "When we shed the armor of the city and the stereotypical labels of society in the deep mountains and dense forests, achieving a state of oneness with our surroundings, Flow is no longer a deliberately choreographed technique, but an instinctive expression in accordance with nature." Witnessed by his partners and nature, he transforms the experience he has absorbed into nourishment for evolution, announcing the birth of an undefined and limitless LAMA 3.0.
